🗣️ Ask Siri about your team: the score, who scored, how the last game went, power rankings, record and playoff chances

caption.facebook:
EyeWall Analytics has a big update on the App Store.

• Siri: ask "What's the score in EyeWall", "Who scored in EyeWall" or "How did we play in EyeWall" and get an answer for your team without opening the app. It works for every NHL, PWHL, AHL and ECHL team, in English and French.
• Salary cap: a Cap tab on every NHL team page, a league-wide cap comparison, and a contract-value board that scores players by production per $1M of cap hit.
• Shootouts: every attempt on the shot map, with the shooter, the result and the game-winner tagged.
• Holiday and seasonal themes for the opening faceoff and the logo, which you can change in Settings.

caption.instagram:
"Hey Siri, who scored in EyeWall?" 🗣️🚨

EyeWall now answers out loud:
• What's the score in EyeWall
• Who scored in EyeWall: the latest goal with its assists, then every scorer
• How did we play in EyeWall: the EyeWall AI recap of the last game
• EyeWall power rankings
• What's our record in EyeWall
• What are our playoff chances in EyeWall

With no team named, Siri answers for your primary team, or for the game on your Lock Screen when a Live Activity is running. Records come out as wins and losses, not "11 to 4 to 1."

Every NHL, PWHL, AHL and ECHL team. English and French.

#hockey #NHL #PWHL #AHL #ECHL #Siri #iPhone
caption.facebook:
You can now ask Siri about your team in EyeWall Analytics, without opening the app.

Try "Who scored in EyeWall" during a game, "How did we play in EyeWall" the morning after, or "EyeWall power rankings" any time. With no team named, Siri answers for your primary team, or for the game on your Lock Screen when an EyeWall Live Activity is running. Name a team to ask about it instead.

It works for every NHL, PWHL, AHL and ECHL team, in English and French, and the same actions are in the Shortcuts app for your own automations.

caption.instagram:
"Hey Siri, how's a player doing in EyeWall?" 🏒

Name the player and Siri reads their season:
• Skaters: goals, assists, points and plus-minus, plus their last game for NHL players
• Goalies: record, save percentage, goals-against average and shutouts

More than 5,000 players across the NHL, PWHL, AHL and ECHL. A last name works too. If two players share it, Siri asks which one.

#hockey #NHL #PWHL #AHL #ECHL #Siri
caption.facebook:
New in EyeWall Analytics: player stats from Siri. Say "How's a player doing in EyeWall", name the player, and Siri reads their season: goals, assists and points, or a goalie's record and save percentage.

It covers more than 5,000 players in the NHL, PWHL, AHL and ECHL. A last name works, and if more than one player has it, Siri asks which one instead of guessing.

items.head: League Cap tab

items.head: Sourced figures

caption.instagram:
Where's your team against the cap? 💰

New Cap tab on every NHL team page:
• Every player's cap hit against the ceiling
• Deals ending this summer, and next summer's free-agent class by status
• An estimate of space before long-term injury relief, with retained salary and buyouts listed

Plus a league-wide cap comparison and a contract-value board that scores every player by production per $1M of cap hit.

Figures come from official announcements and public reports. Reported figures are marked ≈, and a player with no public figure says so.

#NHL #hockey #salarycap #hockeyanalytics
caption.facebook:
EyeWall Analytics now has salary cap data for every NHL team.

• Team Cap tab: each player's cap hit against the ceiling, deals that end this summer, and next summer's free-agent class grouped by status.
• League Cap tab: every team's commitments side by side, by all contracts or by the current roster.
• Contract value: every skater and goalie scored by production per $1M of cap hit.
• Player popups show the contract year by year, with cap hit, salary, signing bonus and clauses where they're public.

Figures come from official announcements and public reports. A reported figure is marked ≈, and a player with no public figure says so rather than showing a guess.

items.head: Your team’s goals
items.text: A shootout goal by your team gets its own alert, with the round and the tally.

caption.instagram:
Every shootout attempt, on the map 🎯

When an NHL game goes to a shootout, EyeWall shows each shooter with the result (goal, save, miss and where it went wide), the goalie they faced, and the game-winner tagged. The score card shows the tally round by round, and your team's shootout goals get their own alert.

#NHL #hockey #shootout #hockeyanalytics
caption.facebook: Shootouts in EyeWall Analytics now get the full treatment. During an NHL shootout the live rink becomes a shootout card: each shooter's photo and result, a slot for whoever shoots next, and the goalie each team faces. The score card shows the tally and round, the event ticker lists every attempt, and a shootout goal by your team gets its own alert. After the final, the card stays under the score.

The opening faceoff dresses up for the holidays 🎃🎄🍁🎆

Halloween's ghost ref, Christmas snow, Canada Day maple leaves, Fourth of July fireworks, and the logo in the top bar joins in. Between holidays come quieter seasonal themes: falling leaves, winter snow, and the Zamboni in the off-season.

Choose holidays and seasons, holidays only, or one theme all year in Settings.

caption.facebook:
A little fun in the latest EyeWall Analytics: on holidays the opening faceoff plays a themed version, from Halloween's ghost referee to Christmas snow, and the logo in the top bar changes too. Between holidays there are quieter seasonal themes, including the Zamboni resurfacing the ice in the off-season.

You choose in Settings: holidays and seasons, holidays only, off, or one theme all year.
